vectors.name: truncated-u64-argument
vectors.why: major-0 says eight argument bytes, only two are present

vectors.name: trailing-byte
vectors.why: one complete int followed by extra data

vectors.name: invalid-utf8
vectors.why: text string payload is not UTF-8

vectors.name: reserved-additional-info-28
vectors.why: additional-info 28 is reserved by CBOR and outside taut's subset

vectors.name: unsupported-major-tag
vectors.why: CBOR tags are outside taut's frozen subset

vectors.name: non-integer-map-key
vectors.why: raw CBOR maps must use integer field-tag keys

vectors.name: duplicate-map-key
vectors.why: same raw CBOR map key appears twice

vectors.name: positive-int-overflow
vectors.why: CBOR major-0 value is just above i64::MAX

vectors.name: negative-int-overflow
vectors.why: CBOR major-1 value is just below i64::MIN

vectors.name: missing-required-field
vectors.why: IntBox.by_id is required and absent

vectors.name: wrong-type-field
vectors.why: IntBox.n wants int, received text

vectors.name: unknown-enum
vectors.why: Mode has no member with wire value 99

vectors.name: non-canonical-int-2byte
vectors.why: value 5 in a 2-byte argument (0x19 0x0005); canonical is the immediate 0x05 (width 25)

vectors.name: non-canonical-int-8byte
vectors.why: value 5 in an 8-byte argument; canonical is the immediate 0x05 (width 27)

vectors.name: negative-map-key
vectors.why: raw CBOR map key -1 (major-1); the canonical encoder only emits non-negative field tags

vectors.name: nested-truncated-string
vectors.why: text string nested inside a map claims 3 bytes but only 2 are present

vectors.name: bytes-length-over-2^53
vectors.why: M1: a byte string (major 2) claims 2^53 bytes and none follow; a length beyond the remaining bytes is Truncated whatever its size, not IntOverflow

vectors.name: array-count-u64-max
vectors.why: M2: an array claims 2^64-1 items and none follow; the first item's missing head is Truncated, not IntOverflow

vectors.name: items-read-in-order
vectors.why: M3: items are read in order, so the first item's tag head (major 6) fails before the four missing items are reached

vectors.name: key-first-duplicate
vectors.why: M4: a map entry's key is checked before its value is read; key 1 repeats and its value is missing

vectors.name: key-first-text
vectors.why: M5: a map entry's key is checked before its value is read; the key is text and its value is missing

vectors.name: key-first-negative
vectors.why: M6: a map entry's key is checked before its value is read; the key is -1 and its value is missing

vectors.name: major-6-info-28
vectors.why: M7: the major type is checked before the additional info; 0xdc is major 6 with the reserved info 28

vectors.name: map-key-2^53
vectors.why: M8: a raw map key of 2^53 is an i64 like any other and decodes; 2^53 is no limit on keys

vectors.name: wrong-type-text
vectors.why: M9: OptBox.note wants text and holds an int; the payload word is `text` (CD-E6), not `str`

vectors.name: wrong-type-array
vectors.why: M10: OptBox.tags wants an array and holds an int; the payload word is `array` (CD-E6), not `list`

vectors.name: optional-absent
vectors.why: M11: an absent optional field is MissingKey; the canonical encoder always writes it, as null when unset

vectors.name: empty-message-not-map
vectors.why: M12: a message with no fields must still be a map

vectors.name: map-field-duplicate
vectors.why: M13: two IntBox.by_id entries share the key 5; a map<K,V> refuses a repeated key rather than keeping the last

vectors.name: map-entry-keys-first
vectors.why: M14: a map<K,V> entry checks for keys 1 and 2 before decoding either; this entry lacks key 2 and its key 1 holds text

vectors.name: optional-present-null
vectors.why: M15: an optional field present as null decodes, to null
